description: A cocktail lounge and restaurant on Long Beach Road in Oceanside that opened in 2026. It turns into a 21-and-over nightspot with DJs after 9 PM.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's 'LIR Dance Party with Andre' on Oct 3 matches the venue's Saturday DJ parties (we found an Oct 17 listing). No Facebook page found. Size of the dance area not confirmed.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Facebook and Instagram were found in the site's own schema data (earlier research found no Facebook page). The site is behind a Cloudflare check, so it was read in a browser. Hours come from the schema data; Monday is not listed (probably closed). The home page text mentions lunch, but the published hours start at 5 PM. No email published. No usable photos: the site's large images are generic stock-style drink and toast shots, not the venue. Current description is still accurate; it could add that Fridays are freestyle/80s/90s/disco dance nights.
hours: Sun, Tue-Wed 5 PM-midnight; Thu 5 PM-1 AM; Fri-Sat 5 PM-3 AM; Monday not listed. 21+ after 9 PM
